bio: A muskox calf whose tail sparks when it gets excited. It chews on a toy rocket and announces the launch date every day; the date keeps moving.
Boosters strapped to its flanks, fur scorched at the edges. It launches at anything, lands on most things, and calls the rest a rapid unscheduled disassembly.
A muskox the size of a lander, red with dust it brought back itself. Its horns fold out into landing legs. It wants to go somewhere nobody has been and build a shed there.
It floats on a cloud of posts and never quite lands. One eye is always on a phone. Its horns are a little bird's wings; it bought the bird.
note: Counts down from ten whenever something is about to happen. Nothing happens.
Its boosters come back and land on their own. It takes the credit.
